resources.string: Off by default. Include the latest available sender avatar, or the notification’s large icon. Uses the chosen image format and JPEG quality.
Off by default. Include the selected source app’s icon. Uses the chosen image format and JPEG quality.
Images from selected apps use the format and limits below. Unavailable images are skipped; text is still forwarded. Connection has a separate block for choosing test images.
PNG uses lossless compression; JPEG quality does not apply. Images may still be resized to fit the size limit.

Off by default. When you open or return to Message487, newly detected apps with launcher icons are selected for notification forwarding. Existing choices stay unchanged; apps you deselect stay excluded. Avoid forwarding loops.
A label sent with each event, for example personal-phone.
Enter the full URL from your published workflow.
Enter an HTTPS URL without embedded credentials or a fragment. Debug builds also allow HTTP to the emulator host or localhost.
Require an accepted response matching the event ID.
Custom webhook: any HTTP 2xx response counts as HTTP success.

Android may delay background work or hide sensitive notification content. Retries reuse the same event ID; a lost response can still cause duplicate delivery. A webhook confirmation does not confirm delivery to Telegram.
Pause capture and queued delivery. A request already in progress may finish.
SMS permission is missing. Enable SMS access in the app permissions.
Some notification images could not be read, or events could not be saved or scheduled. Check available storage, source permissions and the journal.
Could not complete the local operation. Check storage and settings.
Queued events keep the recipient, token and confirmation mode used when they were captured.
Enabled sources send message text, notification images, source names and timestamps to your saved webhook. SMS also includes the sender. Both sources are off initially.
Selected apps only. Ongoing notifications and group summaries are skipped.
New messages, including multipart SMS. No access to your message history.
No applications are selected by default. Add a package manually if it has no launcher icon. Avoid selecting apps that receive your forwarded messages.
Message contents are hidden. Pending events remain until confirmed or explicitly deleted. The journal shows up to 200 entries.
Delete this local record and stop future delivery attempts? This cannot remove copies already received by the server.
Test event saved to the queue. Check the journal for its result.
New messages are not being captured.
Connect an n8n workflow or your own webhook.
Forward notifications only from the apps you choose.
Add an app without a launcher icon using its package name.
Send a test event or enable a source to see delivery activity here.

Prepare an email with a ZIP containing local logs, the last crash and app / Android / device versions. Message contents, senders, webhook URL and device IDs are excluded. Review the attachment before sending in your email app.
Please describe the problem, when it happened and how to reproduce it. Review the diagnostic attachment before sending.
Rotates automatically: 3 × 256 KiB, plus the last crash up to 256 KiB. This preview shows the latest 48 KiB and the last crash. Up to 3 email archives are kept in the app cache.
Could not read, save or share diagnostics. Check available storage and that an email app is installed.
Delete local logs, the last crash and cached email archives? Copies already shared remain with their recipients.
A local crash report may help diagnose the problem. You can review it and prepare an email to the developer. Nothing is sent automatically.
Enter the token without the Bearer prefix. Stored encrypted on this device.
Enter a token without spaces or the Bearer prefix.
No browser is available to open this link.
Skip messages with the same source and exact text within the selected time window.
Checks run about once a day when online. An ignored update is announced again after a week. APKs are downloaded only with your consent.
Android did not identify the installer. Choose an update source.
No newer version is available from this source.
The app or release is not published in this source yet. The source has not been changed.
Could not check or download the update safely. Check your connection and retry. The installed app has not been changed.
Could not open the store, browser, or Android installer. If the download was cleared, check and download again.
The APK has been downloaded and checked. Android will verify it during installation.
Tap Install update. If Android asks, allow installs from Message487, return here and tap the button again. Confirm the update in the system installer.

The APK will be downloaded from GitHub, outside F-Droid’s checks. It may not have been reviewed or reproduced by F-Droid. Continue only if you trust this source. You can cancel and keep using the installed version. Installation requires a separate action.
Notifications are disabled. Allow them to receive update reminders.
Available from %1$s. If ignored, we will remind you in a week.
0 compares exact timestamps. Identical new messages inside the window are also skipped.
No background check has run yet. Android chooses when to run checks.
The last attempt started but has not recorded a result yet.
A newer version was found. Notification delivery depends on system permissions and reminder settings.
A network or temporary server error occurred. A retry is requested after 30 minutes, with increasing delays; Android may defer it.
Android interrupted the check. A retry was requested.
The check failed. Retry manually; the selected source has not changed.

Turn off to send all available attachments without resizing or output size limits. Input decoding safeguards still apply. Limits count attachments separately from the optional avatar and app icon; the size budget includes all images.
Choose extra content for this test only. All options off sends text only. Image format, quality and limits come from Sources → Graphics.
Export saved connection, sources and image settings. Changes in unsaved fields are not included. Files are not encrypted and may contain a secret webhook URL.
ON by default. The file contains your token in plain text. Anyone with the file can read it. Turn this switch off to exclude the token.
Token excluded. Importing this file clears the receiving device’s current token; enter it separately.

Replace saved connection, sources and image settings? Forwarding will be paused until you check the connection and resume it. The queue, history, installation identity and Android permissions are preserved.
No token in file. The current token will be cleared.
Token from file will replace the current token.
Settings imported. Check the connection, then resume forwarding.
Cannot import settings: invalid, unsupported, too large or unreadable file. Nothing was changed.
Read up to 20 recent active notifications from selected apps, including their contents. This does not send anything or pause automatic forwarding. You can pause first to inspect before delivery.
No active notifications from selected apps. Post a new notification and try again.
Preview only: opening this view does not send the event. Automatic capture continues independently.
Forwarding is paused. Close this preview and resume when ready to send.
Images shown above use the selected capture format and limits. Their bytes are sent as Base64 in the images array; the JSON shown contains text metadata only. Credentials are hidden.
Why was a message not forwarded?
Check capture and delivery separately. Notifications or SMS received while capture is off or paused are not saved. Android may hide sensitive content.
Saved URL, device code and token are valid. Send a test to check the receiver.
Configure a valid webhook URL, device code and Bearer token.
This source is disabled. Enable it if you want to capture new events.
No applications selected. Select the apps to forward.
Access is granted, but the notification listener is disconnected. Try reconnecting.
Access is granted, listener connected and apps selected. Try a new notification; duplicate and ongoing notifications may be skipped.
Receive-SMS permission granted. Test with a new incoming SMS, not an old message.
Android reports an active network. This does not prove the webhook is reachable.
No active network. Delivery waits for connectivity.
Android reports background restrictions for this app. Review its battery settings.
No explicit background restriction reported. Doze, battery settings and Android scheduling can still delay delivery. After force-stop, reopen the app.
The server rejected authorization. Check the Bearer token. Existing queued events retain their original credentials.
The receiver did not return status accepted with the matching event_id. Fix its response, or use HTTP confirmation for a custom webhook. Existing events retain their confirmation mode.
Delivery needs attention. Open the event in Journal, fix the receiver or local error, then retry manually.
A temporary failure is waiting for an automatic retry with backoff. Check the network and receiver. You can retry from Journal.
A request is in progress. Wait for its result in Journal.
Saved locally and waiting for Android to schedule delivery. Check pause, network and battery restrictions.
The webhook accepted this event; downstream delivery is not confirmed.
Some notification images could not be read. The preview includes available text and images only.
Event saved to the queue. Check Journal for its result.
This event matches a previous capture and was skipped by the duplicate filter. No new request was queued.
Automatic forwarding is paused. You can send this test without resuming automatic capture or queued message delivery.
